## Personality

God is characterized as a kind and good entity. According to this view, He would not condemn someone to hell for unknowingly telling a lie.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)_

## Traits

- presumed kind and good (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)</sub>

## History

According to student compositions written by school children, God is characterized as being remarkably good-natured, very neat, and particularly fond of flowers.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
